scope: Pure synthetic scalar replay and read-only probes. No operational restore authorization, scientific effect or product integration claim.

D03-01.selection: Prefix-local payload evaluation in supplied physical order, no sorting. Validate initial snapshot/config/container resource bounds first. For each row inspect only EventID and AcceptedSeq to distinguish known historical ID from NEW future row.
D03-01.known_id: A known receipt ID is a prefix retry candidate even if its supplied acceptedseq was changed above cutoff; fully validate and enforce original payload/coordinates via ApplyEvent, so changing header cannot hide a conflict.
D03-01.new_future: For NEW ID with seq>cutoff stop before body/key/evidence/outcome hashing/validation; do not inspect later rows. Do not count this future header. If cursor has not reached cutoff, return incomplete_prefix. Valid future horizon header with corrupted future body cannot alter past snapshot.
D03-01.limits: Whole-file DecodeStrict may reject an invalid raw artifact before ReplayPrefix is called. This API guarantee concerns passed event array evaluation, not a claim that the parent loader never reads disk bytes or that the whole future file was validated.

D03-02.selection: Support suffix arrays and full retransmitted history through receipt-aware ApplyEvent. Do not wrap suffix in EventFileV2, rebase sequence or normalize order.
D03-02.cutoff: Inclusive accepted_seq, not time. Require initial.cursor<=cutoff and final.cursor==cutoff. Historical exact retries before first NEW future row may still be visited after cutoff is reached; they never advance cursor. Missing step/unreachable cutoff is incomplete_prefix; malformed visited row uses fixed existing error.

D03-03.selection: Persisted snapshots contain active/invalidated only. Create a private explicit pending template only for an actual first activate of a full key with matching preexisting current catalog entry. Value=cfg.initial/rev0/sixnull, no clock/event coordinates invented.
D03-03.reuse: For first actual activate of an unseen fullkey, use highest lower-revision prior state of same logical identity through ResetRevision when it exists; otherwise use a private fixed pending initializer, even if a higher fullref already exists and this older exact fullref is explicitly catalog-current. Never reset backward or transfer evidence/value; keep old states. Same logicalID/revision different contenthash remains contradiction.
D03-03.old_declared_fullref: An explicitly catalog-current older fullRef that never had state may receive its own first activation as a separate full key; this is not rollback/reset of the newer state. Never infer exclusion solely from greater revision or Supersedes/tag assumptions. No outcome transfers between keys.
D03-03.alias_collision: Same scope/origin/collection/id/revision with different content hash is revision_mismatch, not an independent revision. Detect contradictory aliases in supplied states/catalog and visited target without inventing CAS authority.
D03-03.nonactivation: Unknown exact state for outcome/exposure/invalidation is missing_state; never query-initialize or create successful virtual neutral state.

D03-04.selection: Use exactly caller-pinned initial synthetic catalog and deterministic ApplyEvent invalidation updates. Catalog may predeclare dormant fullRefs, but does not create state/value before activation. No catalog insertion event/API exists, so do not invent entries/source_refs/epoch/availability from EventV2.
D03-04.missing: Missing exact target current entry is source_unavailable. Catalog expansion requires a separate future accepted parent preparation contract, outside this implementation.
D03-04.equivalence: Full/resume equivalence assumes same declared catalog history and an accepted checkpoint from that history. Unknown external lifecycle facts cannot be discovered from selfhash.

D03-05.selection: Retain every activated full key, including older/invalidated audit rows. Eligibility is exact declared lifecycle status plus valid full-key history. Newer revision does not automatically invalidate an older active tag/view. Only explicit lifecycle invalidation changes its status.
D03-05.limit: These are synthetic declared catalog semantics, not proof a real product reader currently includes a historical revision.

D03-06.selection: Only synthetic accepted-prefix checkpoints supported. Validate prefixchain, all structural receipt histories, state bindings, cursor/minimum bounds and required supplied lifecycle steps. No compaction/pruning or real backup erasure-authorization proof.
D03-06.unsupported: When validation identifies explicit nonempty non-synthetic lifecycle namespace, map that unsupported domain to unsupported_restore at $.receipts.lifecycle_fence.namespace; preserve other earlier structural/hash errors. No new restore mode/authority DTO.
D03-06.honesty: A forged old snapshot and omitted real-world event can look like a consistent declared synthetic checkpoint; this API cannot detect caller intent or authenticate current operational erasure. Do not claim it can.

D03-07.selection: ReadAt validates whole supported snapshot/config coherence and exact target/fullkey. No state creation. Missing exact target missing_state; valid invalidated target invalid_state. Pure view preserves source state reason/revision/activation and prefix.
D03-07.time: atNS<0 invalid_time $.at_ns; atNS<snapshot.cursor.accepted_at time_regression $.at_ns. Valid at>=cursor permits future-time extrapolation, not claim unseen events absent. Exact int64 subtraction before existing scalarDecay; decay disabled returns stored value.
D03-07.pending_boundary: Keep real ValidateTyped validation order. Only translate its specific invalid_state failure caused by the first otherwise individually typed-valid pending row when that first row is exactly requested target to pending_activation $.states[*]. If first pending belongs to another target, or earlier state/field/hash/namespace failure exists, retain that earlier error. Never return a view. Current Snapshot validation bans pending before its parent selfhash check. Do not claim parent hash was already verified. A row hash/shape failure caught earlier is not translated. Raw Snapshot decoder behavior remains unchanged. Narrow rejection-error presentation for direct ReadAt, never successful pending-snapshot acceptance.
D03-07.FD_boundary: ReadAt is generic scalar stored-last decay, not policy-ID inference from config flags. Do not confuse NOOUT and separately registered FD policy; FD-specific anchor semantics remain DYN05 responsibility with its full policy context.

D03-08.selection: Stats count visited/attempted prefix delivery rows only, not unvisited future data or caller planned denominators. AppliedCount means accepted state-changing steps, including activation/outcome/invalidation. NonLearningCount includes exposure/newIDduplicateevidence/invalidated audit; DuplicateEvidenceCount overlaps tagged subset, do not add it twice. Exact historical retry increments DuplicateEventCount.
D03-08.partition: InputCount=AppliedCount+NonLearningCount+DuplicateEventCount+RejectedCount for visited attempts. First rejected row increments Input/Rejected once and stops. Prevalidation or unreachable cutoff has Error but no fabricated rejected row.
D03-08.error_return: On error return zero SnapshotV2 (not a usable target prefix), actual accumulated stats with fixed ContractErrorV2 and nonnil Go error. Inputs/initial/row objects unchanged. Counts describe local attempted computation, not published/DB commits. On success return deeply owned exact cutoff snapshot.
D03-08.resources: Reuse selected original caps: max100000 supplied events/states, max200000 receipts, existing byte/depth/string limits. Container size bound is allowed envelope inspection before prefix payload processing.

D03-09.selection: Every receipt full key requires exactly one retained active/invalidated state; every supplied state requires its valid activation/history. Dormant catalog entry without receipt has no state. No omission/pruning of historical invalidated rows in this supported no-compaction subset.
D03-09.validation: Reuse DYN02 all-key structural receipt validation and per-state revision/reason/activation/last/value-initial context checks, existing Snapshot hash/prefix/fence checks and deterministic canonical fullkey order.
D03-09.efficiency: Group read-only receipt/fence references by fullkey to avoid repeated whole-ledger scans; do not mutate inputs or create a second transition engine/cache/framework.
D03-09.limits: Without original earlier event payloads or an authenticated parent manifest, valid resealed checkpoint hashes do not prove every historical numeric value. Only direct activation-only values are derivable. Full/resume tests use genuinely generated accepted checkpoints, no unsupported authenticity claim.

minimal_header.selection: Minimal header must have existing LegacyID EventID and positive accepted_seq before deciding a future horizon. Inspect only these two fields, no future protocol/key/evidence/outcome/body hashing. Reuse exact existing primitive grammar/UTF8/string bounds, not a second permissive ID regex.
minimal_header.order: Validate EventID first (invalid_unicode/resource_limit/invalid_value at $.event_id per existing primitive rules), then seq>0 (invalid_value $.accepted_seq). Known receipt-ID lookup after header validity always processes original-retry/conflict even if supplied seq>cutoff. NEW valid-header seq>cutoff stops before payload and is not counted.
minimal_header.malformed_header: First invalid minimal header is one attempted/rejected row: InputCount+1,RejectedCount+1,Stats.Error and Goerror set, zeroSnapshot returned; no fabricated applied count. This applies even if its seq field purports to be future, because the horizon envelope itself is malformed.
minimal_header.causal_limit: A valid horizon header with corrupted future body cannot affect earlier snapshot. Malformed structural header may reject the stream; do not broaden the promise to ignore every malformed future delimiter. Parent whole-file decoder may reject before this API.

cost_scope: Grouping initial validation avoids unnecessary repeated scans, but ApplyEvent clones/hashes/validates a growing receipt index. No total linear-time/throughput guarantee for ReplayPrefix. Reuse original engineering bounds and report actual unmeasured cost honestly. No new cache/framework/coefficients.
forbidden: No product Search/DB/API/network/time.Now/model/provider/human/build/deploy/Claude changes. No changes to accepted DYN01/DYN02/R4 source or golden/holdout. No automatic commit/push by author.
